briefs.title: Grok 4.7 holds; Bot and distribution expand
points: Grok 4.7 remains the documented flagship (Sep 21): coding / knowledge work, same price as 4.6, larger base + longer RL.
Listed on Amazon Bedrock and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.
Grok Bot Desktop stable 0.63.0 (macOS Apple silicon & Intel, Windows): team bots, docs, Slack, voice templates, plugins.
Musk highlighted Team Bots, proactive assistant behavior, and Ask Grok in XChat.
Grokipedia v0.3 live; Musk tied it to an Encyclopedia Galactica hiring pitch.
Voice Transcribe 2.0 (Sep 18) claimed ~2× accuracy of 1.0 at the same price.
briefs.assumption: Next flagship more likely a new generation than another 4.x point release, timed to the late-2026 Fable/GPT-6 comment. Grok Bot desktop is the real Mac client—not a separate consumer Grok chat app.

briefs.title: Grok Bot upgrades and Grokipedia v0.3
points: Team bots, Plaid finances, and voice calls that can search chats.
Grokipedia v0.3: refreshed homepage and live-edits view.
Desktop stable moved 0.61 → 0.62 → 0.63 with documents, Slack, marketplace plugins.

briefs.title: Musk sets a 2–3 month bar
points: "Cautiously optimistic that SpaceX will have a Fable/GPT-6 level model in 2 to 3 months."
Same thread: if improvement rate holds, ~6 months to pole position.
Window ≈ late Nov–late Dec 2026; model name not given.

briefs.title: Grok 4.7 ships
points: Most capable for coding and knowledge work; price held at $2 / $6.
Stronger on EEBench and some safety benches; trails Fable on several long-horizon coding tests.
Available in Cursor, Grok Build, API, routers, and clouds.
